description: I am passionate about AI and space exploration. My project, LIFELINE, uses AI and NASA data to predict hazards, simulate scenarios, and improve space mission safety. I am looking for teammates interested in programming, AI, data analysis, and space science. Let's work together to build an innovative solution for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026!
summary: LIFELINE is an AI-powered platform designed to analyze space and environmental data to identify early warning signals, understand potential risks, and support better decision-making. The platform brings together NASA data and other relevant sources to monitor changing conditions, explore possible future scenarios through its What If feature, and compare locations and time periods to identify safer conditions for future missions. LIFELINE also aims to support satellite safety by analyzing surrounding space-object information and assessing potential collision risks. By combining artificial intelligence, data analysis, and interactive visualization, LIFELINE aims to transform complex scientific data into understandable insights and practical recommendations that can help protect our planet and support safer space exploration.
details:
LIFELINE is an AI-powered web platform designed to transform complex space and environmental data into useful insights for safer decision-making.

The platform aims to monitor environmental and space conditions, identify important changes and potential warning signals, and help users understand possible future risks. Its What If feature allows users to explore different scenarios and understand their potential impacts. LIFELINE also includes a satellite safety concept that assesses potential risks from nearby space objects and supports safer mission planning.

The platform combines data analysis, artificial intelligence, interactive dashboards, and scientific visualization. Its main benefits include making scientific information easier to understand, supporting early awareness of potential hazards, and helping users compare locations and time periods when planning future missions.

Our goal is to create a unified decision-support platform that connects Earth observation and space safety in one accessible environment.
